  \caption[{Drive nonlinearity of the bottom code (\(N=0\), \(R\approx\SI{19.6}{\kilo\ohm}\)): voltage deviation from the\,\dots}]{Drive nonlinearity of the bottom code (\(N=0\), \(R\approx\SI{19.6}{\kilo\ohm}\)): voltage deviation from the endpoint chord over \(\pm 90\,\%\) of full scale (\(\pm\SI{40}{\micro\ampere}\)), typical corner, expressed in \SI{1.592}{\milli\volt} ADC LSB. All ten bypass gates are closed at this code and carry the full signal current; their on-resistance rises with the terminal's excursion from \(V_{\mathrm{CM}}\), so the chord --- pinned at the sweep endpoints where that excursion is largest --- overestimates the mid-range voltage by up to \(1.25\,\mathrm{LSB}\), and the deviation is bowl-shaped with a slight skew from the gates' voltage asymmetry.
